# PA — parent-admission role profile r0.5

Exact role: admission of one immutable ordinary-MAP observation or coadd
parent. Required facts: identity, class, lifecycle, quantity/units, WCS,
support, payload domain, missingness, calibration, provenance, and coadd
membership when applicable. Observation and coadd are evaluated separately.
Failure blocks dependent SA/SP; optional downstream roles are irrelevant.
